svg.title: Timeline of the 100 attempts and the agents that made them
svg.desc: Claude Code agents, all on Claude Opus 5.5, from November 1 to 3, 2026 (UTC): 69 attempts one at a time, then eleven parallel rounds of builders with an integrator each, the one-off history pull request, and the output tokens of each pull request. Drawn for this repo from the session usage numbers.
svg.text: 100 attempts, 124 agents, one model: Claude Opus 5.5
Each bar is one agent, from its first message to its last. Times in UTC, November 1 to 3, 2026.
Output tokens per pull request (all of its agents)
pause of about 7.7 h: attempt 35 stalled, then was resumed
Rounds 1 to 9 had three builders and an integrator, one pull request each (#79 to #82, #84 to #88); rounds 10 and 11 had two builders (#89, #90).
Not drawn: the 12 agents of October 31 that helped with #1 to #8, before the chain. The orchestrator ran the whole session, October 31 to November 3.
